what: An 84px ring attached to the screen (thin gray border + SCROLL label in the center) follows the cursor with a lag of 10% of the remaining distance per frame, and stretches in the direction of movement and flattens sideways by the distance moved in one frame × .001 (max .55). Over links and buttons it shrinks to 0 in .3s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) (the label slides out 100% downward). If there is a snap spot (data-stick) inside, it snaps to its center with damping .3 and ignores the mouse until it leaves. data-mode="dot" then an 8px white dot instead of the ring — for when no scroll hint is needed, like mid horizontal swipe. It shrinks and disappears when it leaves the window

options.squeeze: Max squash, default .55 — 0 turns it off
options.stretch: Distortion per px moved per frame, default .001
options.targets: Target that shrinks to 0 (css), default a, button
options.stick: Stick spot inside the target (css), default [data-stick]
options.stick-lerp: Share that follows when sticking, default .3
options.data-mode: dot makes it a dot shape (element attribute — changes follow immediately)
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Label (child) — rises from below only when its first inner element is a ring

note: Hidden on touch devices (hover false) — the original turns it off only when touch and under 1024px. With reduced motion, no lag or squash — it just sits at the cursor position

from.where: index.html .ct-cursor (first page cursor) — original $store.cursor: dampingFactor .1, squeeze min(distance × .001, .55), size-0/size-2/size-[84px] transition-[width,height] 300 ease-quad-in-out, fixedStalker damping .3
